description: What the CURRENT user could GET from another player: the cards in that player's tradelist that the user's decks or personal wantlist still miss. Takes their tradelist link (URL or bare token) or their handle ("@name": every tradelist they published). Each match says you_need, they_offer, wanted_by (the user's deck names, or "Personal wantlist") and copies[] with printing, finish, condition, language and unit_price in `currency` (default USD). A want that pins a printing matches that printing only. A proxy is never offered: the answer holds real cards only, and its proxy fields are always zero. copies[].breaks_decks names the other player's decks that claim or share the copy: say "trading this breaks their deck <name>". A row's lang is the language the user's list asks for; copies[].other_language marks a copy in another language: say "not the language asked for".

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.

link.description: Full share URL, bare token, or a handle written with its @

name: match_tradelist

matches.description: What the user could get from the other player's tradelist

breaks_decks.description: Every deck a trade of this row's copies breaks: relay it before any trade talk
The decks of the copy's owner that claim it or play it shared: say "trading this card breaks <deck>" for each. Empty: no deck plays it

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

is_proxy.description: A PROXY, not a real card: always say so; it counts as zero in value

other_language.description: The list asked for another language (row.lang): these copies are offered all the same. Say "not the language asked for"

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

unit_price.description: Per copy, in currency; null when no price is known

image_uri.description: The wanted card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is: the printing the list pins, else one printing of the card; null when a deck share withholds its printings or the catalogue has none. Each copy has its own

includes_proxies.description: Some of the copies are PROXIES: say so before any trade talk

lang.description: The language the list asks for, Scryfall's code; null any. A preference: other languages are still offered, marked

other_language_quantity.description: Copies not in the language asked for

proxy_quantity.description: How many of the copies are proxies; they count as zero in value

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall, by its name

unpriced_quantity.description: Real copies with no known price: the row's value leaves them out

wanted_by.description: The user's lists that miss it: deck names, or "Personal wantlist"

cards_breaking_decks.description: Copies on this side whose trade breaks a deck, each named on its row

proxy_cards.description: Proxy copies on this side: name them

unpriced_cards.description: Real copies with no known price: the value leaves them out, so say how many

title: Match tradelist
